name: Cache-named folder
description: Folder is named like a cache. Caches are usually regenerated by their owner — check what lives next to it, then reclaim.

name: Temp-named folder
description: Folder is named like a scratch/temp area. Usually safe once its owner is closed — check what lives next to it first.

name: Log folder
description: Log files. Old logs are almost always safe to clear when the folder is large.
